correctness.rationale: The 356,863-face census is exhaustive from all 35 graph edges. Two distinct complete acyclic matchings are verified by topological sorting 2,303,210 Hasse covers, and give two signed integer Morse matrices with 41 and 40 unit pivots and otherwise zero blocks. Thus both Morse CW reductions yield one vertex, 58 six-cells, one seven-cell with null attaching map, giving wedge(58,S^6) vee S^7 by Hurewicz and homotopy CW cancellation. The actual included matrix is byte-independent of the verifier recomputation. No infinite claim is made.

value.rationale: The periodic three-row heptagonal strip is a canonical boundary-condition counterpart of a rigorously classified rectangular seven-column strip. Adding three wrap edges changes the exact homotopy from 55 degree-six spheres to 58 degree-six spheres plus a genuine degree-seven sphere, a structural phenomenon not implied by known connectivity or Euler data. Exhaustive classification of the 356,863-face object is a meaningful finite boundary case that can constrain future cylindrical recurrence conjectures.
